caption: The drawing features a single brass chamberstick, centrally placed against a light, unadorned background. The chamberstick consists of a wide, shallow, circular base with a short cylindrical socket in the center to hold a candle. The base has a smooth, reflective golden-yellow metallic appearance, and the socket has some horizontal lines as decorative bands. Attached to the side of the base is a round finger loop handle, also metallic, with a small straight projection for support. There are two small raised bumps or studs on the base, near the handle. The overall color palette includes various shades of gold, yellow, and brown, with some darker shading to indicate shadow and the curvature of the metal. The artist's signature, "J.M. Jordan," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
